party_basis: the last party primary each voter voted in (the 2026 primaries and May runoffs; Harris, Dallas and Tarrant counties 2024-2026)

party_hints.cast: Everyone who has voted so far by the last party primary they voted in (the 2026 primaries and May runoffs; Harris, Dallas and Tarrant counties 2024-2026), from the official rosters. No recent primary = none in that span, including new voters.
party_hints.mail_voted: Mail ballots received by the last party primary they voted in (the 2026 primaries and May runoffs; Harris, Dallas and Tarrant counties 2024-2026), from the official rosters. No recent primary = none in that span, including new voters.
party_hints.early_voted: In-person early voters by the last party primary they voted in (the 2026 primaries and May runoffs; Harris, Dallas and Tarrant counties 2024-2026), from the official rosters. No recent primary = none in that span, including new voters.

unk_label: counted, but not yet on the rosters
map_note: In-person early votes for 9 counties (Bell, Dallas, Ellis, Hays, Hockley, Madison, McLennan, Montgomery, Travis) come from the county's own live turnout page (updated through the day). Harris's in-person early votes come from the county's own early-voting report, posted each voting evening (ahead of the state's next-morning figure). Every other county's come from the Secretary of State's daily report, which adds each day's in-person votes the next morning, so during the day those counties lag behind. Party is the last party primary each voter voted in -- the 2026 primaries and May runoffs (Harris, Dallas and Tarrant counties: 2024 and 2026) -- matched voter by voter from official rosters: every county's early-voting and mail voters from the Secretary of State's daily roster files (through Oct 26), and Harris County's from its own rosters, which run ahead; the 2026 primary and runoff voters from the state's rosters, and 2024's from Harris, Dallas and Tarrant counties' own (2024's aren't available statewide, and no other county keeps them). Ballots not on the rosters yet, such as today's in-person votes, count as party not reported. 5,044,879 voters matched. Where a county's own early-voting and mail lists run ahead of the state's files, they are read too, a voter on both counting once: Bexar (its mail ballots aren't in the state's files), Collin, Dallas, Denton, El Paso, Fort Bend, Montgomery, Tarrant, Travis, Webb (the county hasn't reported to the state). Where the rosters count more mail or in-person voters than the state's report or a county's live page, the roster count is used for that method: Harris 705,999 (was 702,322), Dallas 454,708 (was 451,612), Tarrant 391,328 (was 387,175), Bexar 349,007 (was 347,394), Travis 318,968 (was 318,209), Collin 252,219 (was 251,482), Denton 223,411 (was 221,824), Fort Bend 185,307 (was 180,647).

source.primary: Texas Secretary of State, Election Information & Turnout Data (unofficial early voting turnout by county, as submitted by county election officials)

party_history.label: official rosters (Texas SoS daily voter files, Harris County rosters) matched to the 2026 (and in three counties 2024) primary rosters
